Maya: FYI nightly CI flagged a p95 regression on small-batch bench for rl-model-v2 quant runs (~15% increase). :ambulance:

Raj: ack. Which bench? smallbatch-1 or throughput-sample?

Maya: smallbatch-1. CI link: https://ci.internal.redwood/ops/1769999999 (logs attached). Perf delta in `bench/results/latest.json` shows p95 240ms -> 275ms.

Tess: :eyes: I can repro locally. Running quick smoke now.

dev-bot: nightly-run finished: 3 fails, 1 flaky. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/nightly/1769999999/

Raj: can you paste the `perf top` snippet? Also try `MALLOC_CONF=prof:true` + jemalloc stats.

Maya: snippet: ```perf record -F 99 -a -- sleep 30; perf report --stdio | head -n 40``` saw stackwalk in decoder.c at ~23% (sampled).

Tess: Repro steps I used: ```./dev/bench run --suite=smallbatch-1 --iter=100 --seed=42``` Getting p95 ~280ms locally.

Raj: Ok plan: run a lightweight bisect across last 5 commits in serving runtime (not model) that touch kernel selection. I'll start with 2026-03-16..2026-03-18 range.

Maya: I've added a quick probe to nightly to dump jemalloc stats and KV-cache hitrates: https://go/ci/notes/1769999999

ops-bot: @eng-runtime we've scheduled a 9:30am sync (UTC) to review traces. Calendar invite sent.

Tess: I'll take the first pass on perf flamegraphs + alloc flame. Raj, can you handle the bisect? ping me if you need a build.

Raj: on it. If I run into noise I'll tag @sre for env check. ETA 2-3 hours. :thumbsup:

Maya: Thanks — leaving notes in the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INFR-8421. If bisect points to quant change we can roll back the quant profile.
